fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The display name of the PersistentResource.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location of the PersistentResource.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The ID to use for the PersistentResource, which become the final component of the PersistentResource's resource name.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The full name of the Compute Engine [network](/compute/docs/networks-and-firewalls#networks) to peered with Vertex AI to host the persistent resources.

fields.label: Reserved IP Ranges
fields.help: A list of names for the reserved IP ranges under the VPC network that can be used for this persistent resource.

fields.label: Encryption Spec
KMS Key Name
fields.help: Resource name of the Cloud KMS key used to protect the resource.
Represents a customer-managed encryption key specification that can be applied to a Vertex AI resource.

fields.label: Psc Interface Config
Network Attachment
fields.help: The name of the Compute Engine [network attachment](https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/about-network-attachments) to attach to the resource within the region and user project.

fields.label: DNS Peering Configs
Domain
fields.help: The DNS name suffix of the zone being peered to, e.g., "my-internal-domain.corp.".

fields.label: Target Network
fields.help: The VPC network name in the target_project where the DNS zone specified by 'domain' is visible.

fields.label: Target Project
fields.help: The project ID hosting the Cloud DNS managed zone that contains the 'domain'.
DNS peering configurations.
Configuration for PSC-I.

fields.label: Resource Pools
ID
fields.help: The unique ID in a PersistentResource for referring to this resource pool.

fields.label: Replica Count
fields.help: The total number of machines to use for this resource pool.

fields.label: Autoscaling Spec
Max Replica Count
fields.help: max replicas in the node pool, must be ΓëÑ replica_count and > min_replica_count or will throw error

fields.label: Min Replica Count
fields.help: min replicas in the node pool, must be Γëñ replica_count and < max_replica_count or will throw error.
The min/max number of replicas allowed if enabling autoscaling

fields.label: Disk Spec
Boot Disk Size Gb
fields.help: Size in GB of the boot disk (default is 100GB).

fields.label: Boot Disk Type
fields.help: Type of the boot disk.
Represents the spec of disk options.

fields.label: Machine Spec
Accelerator Count
fields.help: The number of accelerators to attach to the machine.

fields.label: Accelerator Type
fields.help: The type of accelerator(s) that may be attached to the machine.

fields.label: Machine Type
fields.help: The type of the machine.
Specification of a single machine.
The spec of the pools of different resources.

Service Account Spec
Enable Custom Service Account
fields.help: If true, custom user-managed service account is enforced to run any workloads (for example, Vertex Jobs) on the resource.
Configuration for the use of custom service account to run the workloads.
Configuration for the runtime on a PersistentResource instance.
